I’ve been working on improving the weapon system! Here’s what’s new:

[h3]Weapon Types[/h3] 
You can use melee weapons for close combat or ranged weapons for long-distance fights. Some weapons have higher or lower range, letting you pick the best option for each situation.

notes.title: Dev Log: Energy System
notes.notes:
[h3]Surviving Without Power[/h3]

[h3]Hey everyone,[/h3]

I wanted to share some exciting updates about the game! As you explore the island, you'll quickly notice something unusual—there’s no regular electricity here. But don’t worry, I’ve designed some unique and fascinating ways for you to power up devices and keep things running. Let me take you through how the island’s energy system works.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/ce5f15ef2617ac3d60f7eba6437879fb54a7d863.jpg[/img]

[h3]Daytime Power: Generators and Solar Panels[/h3]

During the day, you’ll need to rely on generators and solar panels to power your devices. Generators are a dependable option, but they run on fuel, so make sure to keep those canisters handy for refills. For a more sustainable solution, you can craft solar panels—though they require advanced materials and crafting skills. It’s all about resourcefulness and planning!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/1beeb7d26960e23cdd68548069f136c1d11f48e1.jpg[/img]

[h3]Nighttime Magic: The Mysterious Light Beam[/h3]

Here’s where things get a little strange. At night, a mysterious light beam provides electricity to the entire island. Suddenly, all the streetlights turn on, and every device comes to life without needing a generator or solar panel. It’s an eerie but fascinating phenomenon that adds a touch of mystery to your survival journey. Why does it happen? Well, you’ll have to play to find out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/2eddce2ba23fd95952bf64834480fb19ec4aa295.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/a553190ee157eeb5296bf09f8ede3aeacc5b1a3a.jpg[/img]

[h3]Experimental Tech: Red Crystals and the Portal[/h3]

I’m also introducing a new experimental power source—red crystals. Certain devices on the island, like the Portal, are powered by these crystals. To activate the Portal, you’ll need to hunt down and collect five red crystals. Once you’ve powered it up, the Portal can teleport you to a new area on the map—a winter biome with its own unique challenges and opportunities. It’s a game-changer for exploration and survival!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/3c1bcc387736a49f1622e4b1122229fb479ac202.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/e5ff80a313604479089149a7702cf89789597abe.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/14e9c9de2924990443a7be3dc681cc270a310f55.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/98d28c0a0ba9f72d1e77cf9f52f2156ddf95dab6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/cca2a9706a34f192d74aefcb0ca9f8fdb0912b16.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/9bd0229fc659748663f143019556415ecfa9cffb.jpg[/img]

I hope this gives you a better idea of how the island’s energy system works. It’s not just about finding fuel or crafting advanced tech; it’s also about uncovering the mysteries of the island and adapting to its unique environment. I can’t wait to hear what you think about these features. Let me know if you have any feedback or suggestions!

[h3]Don't forget to add game to Wishlist![/h3]

notes.title: Dev Log: Farming
notes.notes:
[h3]Hey everyone![/h3]

I'm excited to share some new farming features that I've been working on for the game. These features are aimed at making your survival experience even more immersive and rewarding. Here’s a quick rundown of what you can expect:

[h3]Building Garden Beds[/h3]

You can now build Garden Beds in your farm location. These beds are perfect for planting and growing a variety of plants. Whether you're looking to grow herbs or vegetables, garden beds are essential for your farming journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/4f4411f57f5ab8e7839d620e9c90162cfda30996.jpg[/img]

[h3]Crafting a Farming Station (Shed)[/h3]

One of the new additions is the ability to craft a Farming Station, also known as a shed. Here you will be able to craft new seeds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/32a6df337a3610bec65f88091b87d19d1ef4868a.jpg[/img]

[h3]Getting Started with Planting[/h3]

To start planting, you'll need to have seeds and garden soil. You can find seeds throughout the game world or craft them from vegetables and fruits using the Garden Shed with the Farming Station. Garden soil is essential for providing your plants with the nutrients they need to grow.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/cf4d7a225bac6411afab3ad0bd18dd4b80b01e03.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/9d58411964861dcf556d06402c5d38b3e8ff468a.jpg[/img]

[h3]Watering Your Plants[/h3]

Once you've planted your seeds, you'll need to add water to help them grow. You can use a bucket to water your plants, ensuring they stay healthy and grow efficiently. Remember to check on them regularly to keep them hydrated!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/16ff4865055844e31452afadee136dc14232098f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/de4e0d4ec29a5c0554dab3cd62f1b03f161035bc.jpg[/img]

[h3]Harvesting Your Crops[/h3]

After your plants have finished growing, you can harvest them for eating or cooking. There are several types of plants you can grow, including herbs, beets, cabbage, carrots, eggplants, radishes, potatoes, peppers, berries. Each plant has its own unique benefits and uses, so experiment and find out which ones work best for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/bd59075b1bdb27478d114d622b6e2368fa05ddf5.jpg[/img]

[h3]Building Greenhouses[/h3]

To enhance your farming experience, you can build Greenhouses. These structures improve the growing conditions and speed up the growth of your plants. Additionally, you can upgrade your farming skills at the Knowledge Station to unlock more farming abilities and optimize your crop production.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/2a373472a865d49346b4981b213976488bc77e5b.jpg[/img]

Collecting Berries and Mushrooms

While exploring the island, you can also collect berries and mushrooms in the forest. These resources are valuable for crafting, cooking, and survival. Keep an eye out for them during your adventures!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/7f603645de13063d2b020982dab2bae8e18a2731.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/639603e714e3ba5fd440b99c5b351316553022dd.jpg[/img]

Let me know what you think, and if you have any suggestions or feedback, feel free to share and don't forget to WISHLIST and FOLLOW Outbreak Island.

notes.title: Dev Log: Players Menu (Pre-Final), Abilities
notes.notes:
[h2] Hey everyone! [/h2]

I'm super excited to share some details about the game I'm working on. We've shared glimpses of this before as a work in progress, but now it's more final and polished. Let me take you through the Player's Menu, which is your go-to place for everything you'll need in the game.

[h2]Exploring with Confidence: The Map[/h2]

Your journey begins with the map. As you explore new territories, the map will reveal all the locations you can discover, each one filled with resources and secrets. Keep an eye out for landmarks that might be crucial to your survival.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/a2c8dbf1af2860811f077601a6a7447f36f09a96.jpg[/img]

[h2]Organizing Your Gear: The Inventory[/h2]

Survival isn't just about what you find; it's about how you manage it. I've designed the inventory system with separate slots for ammo and other items, making it easy to find what you need. There's also a weight system, so you'll have to be smart about what you carry. Balance is key!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/d375b48d7f5706c057d69a9f7f51d8c5e27266ed.jpg[/img]

[h2]Keeping Track: Story Quests Journal[/h2]

The Story Quests Journal is where you'll find all the main quests and storylines. This is your guide through the game, helping you stay on track and uncover the mysteries of the world. Whether you're forging alliances or uncovering secrets, the journal has got you covered.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/65e907ab44f16a4f48ae7bbffea90e4a8572d8e0.jpg[/img]

[h2]Taking on Challenges[/h2]

Survival is about more than just staying alive, it's about rising to the occasion. The Challenges section offers various tasks like crafting car upgrades or surviving for a set number of days. Completing these challenges will reward you with resources and achievements that will help you on your journey.

[h2]Learning the Basics: Tutorials[/h2]

For those new to survival crafting or looking to hone their skills, the Tutorials section is full of helpful guides. From crafting basics to advanced techniques, these tutorials will ensure you make the most out of every opportunity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/a89bb5412b024e64db0454f98b7cc92cde725d13.jpg[/img]

[h2]Unlocking Abilities: Knowledge Points and the Knowledge Station[/h2]

As you complete challenges and story quests, you'll earn knowledge points. These points are invaluable and can be spent on a variety of abilities at the Knowledge Station. Whether you want to become a sharpshooter, enhance your resilience, or master the art of stealth, the Knowledge Station has something for everyone. Each ability requires a certain number of knowledge points to unlock, so choose wisely and enhance your survival skills to the max!

[h2]Hello, mystery seekers![/h2]

Today, we want to share some news about the development progress of Outbreak Island, covering locations, vehicle improvements, shooting mechanics, and optimization.

[h2]Location Enhancements and More Loot[/h2]

Until recently, the roads between locations on the island were quite barren, but now we’ve added various objects like houses, abandoned cars, and much more. And all these objects aren’t empty — you’ll be able to find valuable items in them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/4792e3d2667857ef4605b93693b0b22a3ef95b05.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/eaa396c160b08217b7bd14e6d992973e9e54c66a.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/6e415fe5e136d664f1edcca499214a1c5e4b8c15.gif[/img]

[h2]Vehicle Improvements[/h2]

The vehicle is your indispensable companion for survival on the island, so we continue to enhance it.

The first thing we've improved is the vehicle’s physics. We've reworked the suspension behavior, improved collision physics, and enhanced the car's off-road capability.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/7ba211b25a0b5d11651c06a88e754a55f9e5fc3e.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/fa3c56bb05b8a79f10d7109318ed12de11709565.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/dd22bcb5f2da0f7404fa803fbdd6d437da6e481a.gif[/img]

A blown-up car isn't the most pleasant sight, but what about exploding fuel barrels? You can detonate them when enemies are gathered around.

notes.title: HOW TO SURVIVE
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/d4d6076f6ec6d5e9e93804b775d0a0a0cb272b56.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/cd271be5d3e33036d47a6a178325bb863b4d3fa8.png[/img]

⚡The first thing we need to know before heading to the Island is that there is Life on it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/228fc30a915c95496660fb992668bf733f06bfba.png[/img]
In addition to potential encounters with armed units of local military forces that have taken control of half of the Island, we will face inexplicable phenomena in the form of terrifying monsters that appear literally out of nowhere.

 This is facilitated by the presence of a secret laboratory hidden deep in the crater of an extinct volcano.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/5ac206084e859d826a29931f5d9bcb50af837172.png[/img]
Every night, the Emerald Ray illuminates the stormy sky with an emerald flash.
The nature of this phenomenon has not been fully studied, but we know for sure - at this time, flashes of emerald color randomly occur across the island and creepy monsters appear in their place. More detailed information will be provided on site upon arrival. We recommend that you find a safe and comfortable place until you receive the following instructions.

One of the properties of the Emerald Ray is to activate electricity on the island. Use this privilege wisely. Harvest fuel for transport and generators, utilizing heavy machinery for processing resources.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/3cc49bb3649dbee492921de574046b8f3d6dfa17.gif[/img]

But remember! On a random night, instead of the Emerald Ray, the Amber Ray appears and it is very dangerous! Stock up on ammunition and stay at home.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/fc8725ad1e9f47c8f838cda4ffc777948b7c6036.gif[/img]
 We don’t advise anyone to go out on a night like this.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/2b801ddd50a27d42de0bc295d0ff71b5d8ae496f.png[/img]
It was nicknamed the Amber Portal by the first Survivors, whose hidden treasures are legendary!
But not everyone is destined to find them.. At this dangerous time, monsters with redoubled force attack the world of the Island from flash portals. And according to the latest data from our investigation team, the amount of valuable loot is also increasing.
But be extremely careful! If you come too close to the Amber Portal (of course, if you are still alive, because the monsters from there are much more powerful than those from the Emerald Flashes), you will immediately be teleported to the harsh winter expanses of Amber Peak Mountain.
And from there, few people returned intact.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/f74c9038d1c0a714784f503130636d99f6bbe64b.png[/img]
When a beam of super-powerful electromagnetic energy bursts forth from the depths of the Emerald and Amber Peaks, it attracts all air and water transport to the Epicenter of the Outburst, resulting in many interesting places to explore both on the island and underwater nearby.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/33690b4c9da7e862ae856bf0eada52b3c8526478.png[/img]

notes.title: Outbreak Island: Big Devlog #1 (video and text)
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we are Tiny Magicians studio and this is a devlog about our upcoming game Outbreak Island. Today we're going to talk about what makes our game unique compared to other survival sims, show some basic gameplay, and talk about the creation and development of the dynamic open world in Outbreak Island.

[b]Video version:[/b]https://youtu.be/JLHWxW3f9R4

In the game, you will have to survive as a detective. Hunting and farming are at your service for saving your own life. And don't forget about the sleep - there is a tent for this purpose in the game. The campfire is not just a source of light, but also a tool for cooking. You can also pass the time on this scary island quite comfortably around the campfire. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/50971ddd02181c03663d27e3a853d43b2b9d8f2b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/ccd3458044d17d3ba536fce7455c4dd07efe841c.jpg[/img]


By the way, the nights in Outbreak Island are very beautiful, but dangerous. And a couple of bullets are obviously not enough to survive them. This is the point at which Outbreak Island deviates from other survival sims. One of the detective's main survival tools is his camera. You can use flash to blind the mysterious Transformed, and escape. Plus, a tripod will help you remotely observe what's going on and even hunt. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/127abe594df5a824bc4ba7341410567234221f22.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/95714e05d338152c8ec06a9433fa483812b145b5.jpg[/img]

The in-game island is not only about nature, but it’s also an abandoned city, factories, farms, and military bases. Exploring these places is not an easy task, as useful items are sometimes hidden in unexpected places. So you will have to jump as much as possible.

The weather in Outbreak Island is constantly changing. It can go from a calm, clear day to a wild storm. Don't forget to find shelter! And by the way, check out how the sound changes if you go indoors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/5e09c54ff384b6a508d284e16db60d03ddce3708.gif[/img]

We are also happy to tell you that in Outbreak Island you can travel not only on foot, but also by car. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/1e226122f7b5a332706c1b285cab9bf5f363d292.jpg[/img]

Since we're talking about the island as a whole, it's really big and varied in the game. Mountains, forests, hills, glades and caves. We pay great attention to visuals everywhere: not only natural, but also man-made: buildings and rooms look as if they were really inhabited by people once.

That's it for today! If you liked what you saw, don't forget to add Outbreak Island to your Wishlist on Steam. We'll have more news on the game's release and development progress soon. Thanks and see you around!

And add the free Outbreak Island: Pendulum prologue to your Wishlist, which will be released very soon!

We continue to work on Outbreak Island, and today we want to tell you a little bit about the game’s open world. 

As we have already mentioned, you will be surviving on Erlsen Island. The area of the island is about 16 square kilometers. We have chosen this size to avoid large boring spaces. However, we also hope that you will not get crowded on the island and enjoy both beautiful views and long journeys.

The time of day changes as well since we're talking about the changes! Imagine sitting in your camp at night with your tent by the fire, traps set around for safety, and a tripod-mounted camera allowing you to follow what's going on from the comfort of your seat. notes.title: Dev Diary #2: Story, open world and The Transformed
notes.notes:
Greetings, detectives!

We continue to keep a development diary of Outbreak Island, a detective survival simulator. Today we’d like to tell you about our work on the story campaign, elaboration of the open world, restricted locations and development of the local population — the Transformed.

[h2]Story[/h2]

There’ll be two game modes in Outbreak Island: story campaign and free survival. For now, we’ve finished working on the main storyline and started developing the side quests, as well as writing the script for the characters’ VO. We plan to involve professional actors to make OI characters truly alive and emotional. 

Read an excerpt from the main character's diary to plunge into the atmosphere of exploration, detective and survival.

[i]This is an unfamiliar solitude. As if the only connection with the real world has been lost. However, self-reflection has never been a part of my nature — I’ll keep on exploring this goddamn island at first light. Nothing remarkable has been spotted in the forest so far. Except for animals going crazy. Wolves are usually not so aggressive, and that bear... was it even a bear or something different? And since when do bears leave traces that are visible under ultraviolet light? I should find the locals quickly and discover what is going on here.  [/i]

[h2]Open world[/h2]

In Outbreak Island, you’ll have to explore a large island with an area of more than XXX square kilometres. Throughout your journey, you will wander through forests, explore caves, climb hills and even sheer cliffs. In addition to wildlife, the island also has civilization. For instance, a small town, farms, and an abandoned church. Besides, you will have to go down to the underground labs to advance along the story and solve this case. Look at how we are gradually improving the environment in Outbreak Island:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/efeace9dbbbe48dc7bea862a687b09bae9b3ef79.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/0ecee262b51f32ef1d2f9402db28283fc9f35a37.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/28bc2bf656758a018d8371450b9c83279e5a5a6e.gif[/img]

[h2]The Transformed[/h2]

Initially, the detective was opposed by zombies in the plot concept. We decided to deviate from the common idea of the zombie apocalypse and do something new instead. Feast your eyes on the Transformed concept art. They didn't die to be resurrected and eat brains afterward. They are still living people, yet something terrible happened to them. The Transformed are not aware of the reality and are quite aggressive. It's up to you to sneak past them, distract the Transformed with the camera flash remotely, attack them from behind or head-on. However, keep in mind that, firstly, these are still living people indeed. Secondly, they are truly dangerous, and the main character is a common man with no prior combat training. Moreover, you’re constantly running short of ammo. 

We’ll tell you more about the Transformed in the next development diaries, but for now, check out their concept art:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/580fefa52e10d7ed2f6a8547e557db1290eb26e4.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone! 

My name is Egis and together with my wife, I am developing Outbreak Island, an open-world detective survival simulator. We like games of this genre, so we decided to make our own :) This is our first project as the Tiny Magicians team, although I have a few finished games in my portfolio. So far Outbreak Island is the biggest project in my career, and I am sure that you will like this game. In addition, thanks to the support of the publisher HypeTrain Digital we have engaged professional developers.

Today we want to tell you more about Outbreak Island and its creation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/8e94a46224f0d2855cb90af09867403034791a63.png[/img]

We are developing the game on Unreal Engine 4. Outbreak Island will have a story mode and a survival mode. The world of OI will be constantly changing - weather, time of day and unexpected encounters with local inhabitants will create unique situations and provide unpredictable gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/4c8f97b6636b260ca7f144371fd88529630fb622.png[/img]

Taking on the role of Robert Chapman, you arrive on a mysterious island to investigate a missing person case. Due to a storm, you are cut from the outside world. So you must survive on the island, solve the case, find a way to escape or you might end up staying here forever.

Right now we're working on the dialogue script so we can get professional voice actors. We're also working on the quests and deepening the Outbreak Island lore.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/0a7851256910ee386ebc6800356a6cf4a1fcfb1c.png[/img]

The detective feels thirsty and hungry. He might get tired or injured from a fall, an encounter with wild animals or... something else entirely. To survive, you will have to scavenge for food, medicine and other supplies. Whether you hunt or be preyed upon is up to your survival skills.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/ce141bf90fd058721e748d95af82c418c516daca.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/f59dc7e7e53742c7a1c224960c14bfe240e1b28c.png[/img]

Camera is your main tool of survival. Distract the infected with Camera's flash. Access your camera remotely and study the behaviour of the locals. Take pictures of anything suspicious to get clues and investigate the disaster.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/eab4037dc9ede59c879769d235c44092a40a7150.jpg[/img]

Uncover the secrets of an uncharted island. There is an abandoned town, farms, and even electricity. Where did it come from? And where did the local population go?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/3f2fc3d12c59f56b5b93d349f2962bddc4afc64e.gif[/img]

Keep yourself safe with handmade traps, shelter, useful equipment, and weapons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/19474ff37a14f8412d3b08a4c6681acdbd090398.png[/img]

Add Outbreak Island to your Wishlist and join our Discord and Twitter! We'll be posting dev diaries every month and showing the development progress. For now, Outbreak Island is scheduled to release in Early Access in Q3 2021.
